context: Router precision: a full demo-portal request ('create a demo portal for Acme using acme.com … assets already in Adobe, enrich them') must still route to the full flow (rebrand + assets + collections) and must NOT be downgraded to a partial visual run just because the partial lane also uses a source URL and the word 'portal'.

checklist.name: Routes to the full demo (rebrand + assets + collections)
checklist.description: The agent plans/runs the complete demo: rebrand plus bringing in and organizing the company's assets so they are searchable, plus ready-made collections — not a visual-only change.

checklist.name: Does not downgrade to a look-only run on account of the URL or 'portal'
checklist.description: The agent does not treat the acme.com URL or the word 'portal' as a reason to skip assets/collections; assets remain in scope.

checklist.name: Treats assets as enrich-existing, enriched now, and does not re-ask asset source
checklist.description: Because the request says the assets are already in Adobe and to enrich them, the agent uses the enrich-existing lane with immediate enrichment and does not re-ask where the assets come from or whether to enrich now vs later.

checklist.name: Runs the mandatory foundation before design (branch + DA copy)
checklist.description: The agent confirms the demo, creates/checks out a branch of the current repo (no fork), and copies the existing DA content into the company folder before any design/styling work.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No 'intent', mode names, 'branch', 'daFolder', 'excat', 'Step N', or other internal mechanics surfaced to the customer as jargon.
